info.title: nnke-platform
info.description: CLI tool for Ananke federation — validate deployability, deploy workflows to cloud platforms (Azure AI, Vertex AI, Claude), manage deployment profiles, and inspect platform capabilities.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Ananke Platform CLI — validate, deploy, and manage workflow federation to cloud platforms. For scaffolding and inspection, use nnke.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON output instead of human-formatted text. [default: False]

options.name: --in-memory
options.description: Use an ephemeral in-memory deployment registry instead of the default file-backed one. Useful for testing. [default: False]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a manifest's deployability to a target platform.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform to validate against (e.g. azure-ai, gemini-agent-platform, vertex-ai, claude).

options.name: --profile
options.description: Deployment profile name from the manifest's profiles: section. When set, tools are rebound before validation.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Filter to a specific platform (e.g. azure-ai). Omit to list all.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Score a manifest against candidate platforms and recommend the best fit.

options.name: --candidates
options.description: Restrict evaluation to these platform identifiers (e.g. azure-ai foundry claude). Defaults to all known platforms.

options.name: --weight-capability
options.description: Weight for the capability-coverage axis (default 1.0).

options.name: --weight-strength
options.description: Weight for the strength-alignment axis (default 1.0).

options.name: --weight-cost-latency
options.description: Weight for the cost-and-latency axis (default 0.5).

options.name: --weight-governance
options.description: Weight for the governance-fit axis (default 1.5).

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text (default), json, or markdown. [default: text]

options.name: --live
options.description: Run a live structural validation pass per candidate using the local emulator registry. Errors become Block reasons; warnings become Minus reasons. [default: False]

options.name: --emit-rules
options.description: Write the recommended platform as a HybridRouter routing-rules JSON file to the given path.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the .ananke.yml manifest file. When omitted the current directory is searched.

commands.name: profiles
commands.description: List or inspect deployment profiles in a manifest.

arguments.name: PROFILE
arguments.description: Profile name to inspect. Omit to list all profiles.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploy a workflow to a target platform.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target platform (e.g. azure-ai, gemini-agent-platform, vertex-ai, claude).

options.name: --profile
options.description: Deployment profile name from the manifest's profiles: section.

options.name: --force
options.description: Force re-deployment even if an active deployment exists. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate and show what would be deployed without actually deploying. [default: False]

options.name: --deployment-id
options.description: Specific deployment ID to query. Omit to list all deployments.

options.name: --workflow
options.description: Filter results by workflow name.

commands.name: teardown
commands.description: Tear down a deployed workflow and release platform resources.

options.name: --deployment-id
options.description: Deployment ID to tear down.

commands.name: trends
commands.description: Show metrics trends (tokens/exec, tool-calls/exec) for remote deployments.

options.name: --deployment-id
options.description: Specific deployment ID to show trends for. Omit to show all trackable deployments.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze a manifest's structural complexity and correlate with runtime metrics.

options.name: --deployment-id
options.description: Active deployment ID to correlate with runtime metrics trends.

commands.name: lineage
commands.description: Show the ancestor/descendant lineage tree for a cell, annotated with platform info.

arguments.name: CELL
arguments.description: Cell name to show lineage for.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a host snapshot YAML file.

commands.name: mesh
commands.description: Show alive cells with platform, deploymentId, and remote health. For scaffolding/inspection, use nnke mesh status.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a host snapshot YAML file.

commands.name: apoptosis
commands.description: Identify idle or aged cells eligible for teardown. Dry-run unless --auto is passed.

options.name: --auto
options.description: Execute teardown for prunable cells. Without this flag the command is a dry-run. [default: False]

options.name: --idle-minutes
options.description: Minutes since snapshot before a cell is considered idle (default: 15). [default: 15]

options.name: --max-age-days
options.description: Maximum cell age in days; cells without birth metadata are ignored (default: 7). [default: 7]

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a host snapshot YAML file.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare token/latency/error metrics across platforms for a named cell.

options.name: --across
options.description: Comma-separated list of platforms to compare (azure, google, anthropic). [default: System.String[]]

arguments.name: CELL
arguments.description: Cell / workflow name to compare across platforms.

commands.name: events
commands.description: Stream colony events: division signals, stress changes, deploy/teardown. Polls every 2 seconds; persistent SSE streaming is a v0.9 upgrade.

options.name: --follow
options.description: Keep streaming until Ctrl+C (polls every 2 seconds). Without this flag prints one snapshot. [default: False]

commands.name: login
commands.description: Configure credentials for a federation platform.

options.name: --platform
options.description: Platform to authenticate: azure, google, or anthropic.

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show the currently configured identity for each federation platform.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all adapters found in the probe directory and their load status.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Report adapter health: flags version mismatches, missing manifests, and load failures.
